author: Sideprojects
description:
This episode ranks twelve extraordinarily valuable objects sold at auction, from a 1926 Macallan whisky bottle fetching nearly three million dollars to Leonardo da Vinci's Salvator Mundi painting selling for over four hundred and fifty million. Featured items include rare stamps, Stradivarius violins, dinosaur fossils, luxury watches and historic documents.
